portal_hypertension.title: Efficacy and safety of belapectin for the prevention of esophageal varices in patients with MASH cirrhosis: The randomized, placebo-controlled NAVIGATE trial.
portal_hypertension.authors: Chalasani N, Vuppalanchi R, Noureddin M
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：Belapectin 可减少 MASH 肝硬化患者亚组中静脉曲张的发展。 临床提示：我们报告了贝拉菌素对基线时无静脉曲张的 MASH 肝硬化和门静脉高压患者的疗效和安全性。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Belapectin reduced variceal development in a subgroup of patients with MASH cirrhosis. We report the efficacy and safety of belapectin in patients with MASH cirrhosis and portal hypertension without varices at baseline. NAVIGATE was a global Phase 2b trial. Patients were randomized to intravenous (IV) belapectin 2 or 4 mg/kg lean body weight or placebo for 18 months stratified by type 2 diabetes. The primary endpoint was the incidence of varices with esophagogastroduodenoscopy (EGD) or a composite endpoint (new varices, intercurrent events or discontinuation) at 18 months with belapectin versus placebo in the Full Analysis Set (FAS). portal_hypertension.title: Evaluation of liver function and related factors in patients with chronic hepatitis B-related cirrhosis complicated with esophagogastric variceal bleeding.
portal_hypertension.authors: Feng Y, Li B, Zhu Y
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：本研究旨在评估慢性乙型肝炎（CHB）相关肝硬化并发食管胃静脉曲张出血（EGVB）患者的肝功能及相关因素。 临床提示：从多中心数据库中筛选出CHB相关肝硬化并发EGVB的患者。
portal_hypertension.abstract: This study intended to evaluate liver function and related factors in patients with chronic hepatitis B (CHB)-related cirrhosis complicated with esophagogastric variceal bleeding (EGVB). Patients with CHB-related cirrhosis complicated with EGVB were screened from the multicenter database. Patients were divided into Child-Pugh A, B, and C based on Child-Pugh scores. Clinical characteristics and laboratory findings were collected to explore factors affecting good liver function (Child-Pugh A: good liver function; Child-Pugh B or C: poor liver function). portal_hypertension.title: Computed tomography imaging features aid in identifying cirrhotic patients with poor response to endoscopic therapy for gastroesophageal variceal hemorrhage.
portal_hypertension.authors: Rao C, Wu L, Huang X
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究（样本量约为 158）。核心观点：探讨计算机断层扫描 (CT) 成像特征是否有助于识别对胃食管静脉曲张出血 (GVH) 内镜治疗反应不佳的肝硬化患者。 临床提示：回顾性纳入有 GVH 内镜治疗史的肝硬化患者 (n = 158)。
portal_hypertension.abstract: To investigate whether computed tomography (CT) imaging features can aid in identifying cirrhotic patients with poor response to endoscopic therapy for gastroesophageal variceal hemorrhage (GVH). Cirrhotic patients with a history of endoscopic therapy for GVH were retrospectively enrolled (n = 158). Pre-endoscopic data, hepatic venous pressure gradient (HVPG), and endoscopic and CT imaging data were collected and analyzed.
